steps.label: verificar estado Claro em Sidebar, Central e MobilePreview
steps.js: (() => { const side = document.querySelector('aside'); const preview = document.querySelectorAll('aside')[1]; const main = document.querySelector('main') || document.querySelector('h1').closest('div'); return JSON.stringify({ isLight: document.documentElement.classList.contains('light'), sideColor: getComputedStyle(side).color, previewColor: getComputedStyle(preview).color }); })()

steps.label: verificar preto absoluto AMOLED em Sidebar, Central e MobilePreview
steps.js: (() => { const side = document.querySelector('aside'); const preview = document.querySelectorAll('aside')[1]; const root = document.querySelector('#root > div'); return JSON.stringify({ isAmoled: document.documentElement.classList.contains('amoled'), sideBg: getComputedStyle(side).backgroundColor, previewBg: getComputedStyle(preview).backgroundColor, rootBg: getComputedStyle(root).backgroundColor }); })()

steps.label: verificar modo Escuro
steps.js: (() => { const side = document.querySelector('aside'); const root = document.querySelector('#root > div'); return JSON.stringify({ isDark: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'), rootBg: getComputedStyle(root).backgroundColor }); })()
